caption: The drawing features a single bed with an ornate design. The bed has a tall headboard that is elaborately decorated with carved details, including a central circular motif, curved and scroll-like patterns, and symmetrical flourishes. Above the headboard, there is a canopy supported by four posts, two of which are visible and have vertical grooves. The canopy is depicted with simple lines indicating draped fabric, and its top surface is flat with a slightly beveled edge. The footboard also has an arched shape with a matching central circular motif and similar carved patterns mirroring those on the headboard. The bed is shown with bedding that follows the contours of the mattress, which is tucked in neatly, and the entire composition is rendered in grayscale, suggesting pencil or ink with varying shades from light gray to black, against an off-white background.
title: Half-canopy Carved Bed
